entities.summary: Endel Eduard Taniloo, born Danilov, was an Estonian sculptor and recipient of Order of the White Star in 2002. He was born in Tartu. He was the brother of the actress, theater director, and journalist Kadi Taniloo, and the grandfather of the linguist Mari Uusküla.
